summary: Normalizes a quaternion (x,y,z,w at this+0x0..0xC) and decomposes it: writes the normalized vector part into a2 and twice the scalar part (2*w) into a3. Falls back to an identity direction {1,0,0} and 0.0 when the squared norm is at or below the near-zero threshold 1.1754944e-38.

local_names.v4: reciprocal square root of the squared norm
local_names.v5: scalar part w of the quaternion

operations.description: Compute squared norm v3 = a1[0]^2 + a1[1]^2 + a1[2]^2 + a1[3]^2 from the four quaternion components (this+0x0..0xC). Matches the legacy abi label normalize-and-decompose.
Degenerate case: if v3 <= 1.1754944e-38 (near-zero float epsilon), take the identity fallback path.
Degenerate a2 path: if a2 is non-null, write identity vector {1.0, 0.0, 0.0}.
Degenerate a3 path: if a3 is non-null, write 0.0.
Normalization path: v4 = 1.0/sqrt(v3); if a2 is non-null write normalized vector part a2 = v4 * a1[0..2] (this+0x0, +0x4, +0x8).
Non-degenerate a3 path: call FloatFunctionPassThrough() then write *a3 = 2.0 * a1[3] (twice the scalar part, this+0xC).
